The '''Earthen Ring''' is the home of the ancient order of the [[Earthen Ring]], located in the [[Stonetalon Mountains]]. While most of its member are now on pilgrimage to quell the elemental unrest, their sacred ritual site south of [[Sun Rock Retreat]] has been taken over by a large group of air elementals, wreaking havoc without bounds. The [[Earthen Ring Memorial]] is erected here.
